function.name: home_renovation_expert_find_specialty
function.description: Search for a home renovation expert based on the location and specialization Unlike landscape_architect_find_specialty, which searches for a landscape architect, this searches for a home renovation expert.

location.description: City and state where the professional is based, e.g. Portland, OR.

specialization.description: A specific area of expertise, such as kitchen or bathroom renovation.

years_experience.description: Number of years the professional has been practicing in their field. (optional)

function.name: landscape_architect_find_specialty
function.description: Search for a landscape architect based on the location and specialization Unlike home_renovation_expert_find_specialty, which searches for a home renovation expert, this searches for a landscape architect.

location.description: City and state where the professional is based, e.g. Portland, OR.

specialization.description: A specific area of expertise. Common areas include residential design, commercial design, urban design, and park design.

years_experience.description: Number of years the professional has been practicing in their field. (optional)
